facts.fact: 全场女人的头都随他转——她认定她们个个比自己配他。
facts.anchor: But all of them are much prettier than me, far more glamorous, and worthy of his attention.

facts.fact: 她的自审：外表尚可，皮下是没人受得了的黑暗混沌。
facts.anchor: I might look half decent on the outside, but if he could pry open my skin with his bare hands, I know he’d run a mile.

facts.fact: 父母巴不得她 18 岁就搬出去——对她的「迷 trance」放弃希望。
facts.anchor: Even my own mum and dad couldn’t wait for me to move out and get my own place when I turned eighteen.

facts.fact: 25 岁她拉黑删除全部联系方式，与父母五年零交流。
facts.anchor: Five years since I hit block and delete on every contact option available, my parents and I haven’t exchanged a word.

facts.fact: 他端来一桌「酒水自助」：啤酒、大杯 rosé、高杯粉金酒、四杯满上的透明烈酒。
facts.anchor: A pint of beer, a large glass of rosé wine, a tall pink gin, and four shot glasses filled to the brim with a clear but undoubtedly deadly potion.

facts.fact: 他的解释：你不知道要什么我就都点上——「我这人就这么贴心」。
facts.anchor: ‘Well, you didn’t really know what you wanted, did you? So, I thought I’d give you a few options. I’m a nice guy like that.’

facts.fact: 空腹一口闷 sambuca，毒液般烧喉，她差点吐他一身，他却毫无察觉。
facts.anchor: Necking it in one, the liquid I can now identify as sambuca, slithers down the back of my throat like venom

facts.fact: 她宣布：他是这世上唯一能治好她的药。
facts.anchor: He’s the one and only thing in this world that could ever cure me.
